enforcement.agentContainer: internal-only run network; reachable endpoints: gateway:8811 (Bearer auth) and llm-proxy:3128 (CONNECT allowlist: api.anthropic.com:443); no workspace, output, or docker-socket mounts; model API key present by necessity
enforcement.dataAccess: declared tickets; no servers cataloged by policy (declaration recorded for audit)
enforcement.exec: run_command restricted to argv0 allowlist + shim PATH {git, jq}; tools container is the runner image with the operator's catalogued packages installed (git ← apk git, jq ← apk jq) and minimized to exactly those binaries (per-QuickAgent exec image); git: safe.directory covers the run's workspace and inputs mounts in the image's /etc/gitconfig, so a bind mount owned by the host user is not refused as dubiously owned
enforcement.filesystem: read workspace; write paths {notes/summary.md, reports} — enforced by the tools-container mount table (ro/rw, per-path binds) plus server-side grant checks; the run's docker filter (in the CLI on Linux, in a container of the run's own on Docker Desktop) mounts the tools container's /tmp as a 256 MiB tmpfs and the tools server refuses to serve without it; where no filter runs it is the container's own layer, unbounded
enforcement.model.apiKey: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the host environment, injected into the agent container (or the host harness process) only
enforcement.network: egress pinned to declared hosts via gateway per-server proxies + DNS interception (--block-network) and re-checked per request/redirect hop by the fetch tool: api.example.com, api.other.net
enforcement.pdf: the runner's grant, not the contract's: export_pdf renders a Markdown file from reports/ or the scratch folder into a PDF in reports/ with Typst 0.15.1 in the tools container (built without a package downloader), through the runner's confine role: an empty environment, a fresh render root under /tmp whose every file the tools server makes new, no write of its own (Landlock; the PDF comes back on its stdout), TCP refused where Landlock is ABI 4 or later, 1 GiB of address space and 60 seconds; as root it runs as a user of its own that owns nothing, and where there is no Landlock that user is all that holds its writes. Only local PNG and JPEG images from reports/, the scratch folder and the inputs are drawn. The theme is the run's, never the model's, and the receipt's pdfs block names it and each PDF's SHA-256; write_report refuses a PDF
enforcement.runtime: runsc: the run's containers are created with docker --runtime runsc where it holds; the receipt's runtime line names each container class, and each that takes the daemon's default and why
enforcement.scratch: the runner's grant, not the contract's: scratch_list, scratch_read, scratch_write and scratch_search over the scratch folder /scratch on the tools container only, empty at the start, never copied to the output folder, and removed with the container; a 256 MiB tmpfs the run's docker filter mounts (in the CLI on Linux, in a container of the run's own on Docker Desktop), and where no filter runs a folder in the container's own layer, unbounded; fetch saves a response body there, of any type, when the agent names a path (saveTo) or the body is larger than one tool result: only from the declared egress above, with every redirect hop checked, refused when the body holds a granted secret's value as written (a body the host sends gzip-, deflate- or br-encoded is decoded first; one in any other coding, in more than one, or decoding past 64 times the reply cap is refused), never executable, and each save recorded in receipts/fetches.ndjson
enforcement.search: the runner's grant, not the contract's: grep and glob search and list, one area a call, only what the run's other tools read (its inputs unless under the review grant, attached knowledge packs, the scratch folder, the workspace only as filesystem.read grants it), with ripgrep 15.2.0 in the tools container (built from pinned source, no PCRE2), through the runner's confine role: an empty environment, a fixed argument list that never asks it to start another program or follow a link, reads held to the searched area and no write of its own (Landlock), TCP refused where Landlock is ABI 4 or later, 512 MiB of address space and 30 seconds; as root it runs as a user of its own that owns nothing, and where there is no Landlock that user is all that holds it. A search of the inputs answers as the person's own input, as search_inputs does
enforcement.secrets: values resolved at run start (missing ⇒ refuse, exit 11), injected only into the tools container via gateway secret scoping, absent from plan and receipts: EXAMPLE_TOKEN; the MCP gateway, which injects them, reads the run's whole secrets file, so its container holds every value too
enforcement.toolResults: every result of the runner's own tools is held to 48 KiB and 1,900 lines, the docker-agent harness's measured tool-result limit less a margin, by the tools server: a file is read a page at a time from the offset asked, each page saying where the next begins; a listing or a search stops at it and says what it left out; any other result is cut at it with a notice saying so; declared MCP servers' results are their own; a fetch response body larger than one result is saved to /scratch/fetch/ (never executable, refused when it holds a granted secret's value) and answered with its first page
